recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not reopen FHIR-6253 to convert BodyStructure into a datatype or perform broad consistency edits; future bodySite/bodyStructure cleanup should be handled by current-version OO trackers such as FHIR-53203/FHIR-54843 or their successors.
issue_request: FHIR-6253 requested making body site a datatype and using it consistently across the standard, including imaging and medication administration. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution kept BodySite as a resource for cases needing an independently tracked site and used simple coded body-site elements plus extension-based resource references where needed.
initial_application: Historical #6253 commits 6cc9083b, c765f2b, and f23d7a updated MedicationOrder, MedicationAdministration, and MedicationDispense site fields and examples so pharmacy site fields could carry a coded site or BodySite reference. FHIR-7647 recorded the pharmacy companion decision for consistency across pharmacy resources.
additional_context: FHIR-13396 later renamed BodySite to BodyStructure, and fhir.ini now actively builds bodystructure=BodyStructure while listing BodySite as removed. FHIR-53203 later moved listed OO resources toward bodyStructure CodeableReference(BodyStructure) elements. The standard bodySite extension is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack and targets BodyStructure, so its absence from core source is not a missing core edit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current core source retains BodyStructure as an active resource for detailed or persistent anatomical structures, keeps coded body-site fields where that remains the appropriate 80% representation, uses CodeableReference(BodyStructure) on later harmonized surfaces, and relies on the standard bodySite extension where extension-based references are intended.
